character: Olympia Myklos's first private office conversations
voice: Tender, secretive, and unsettling without changing the deliberately unidentified listener or the scene's ambiguity.

entries.text: Oh! What are you doing here, my darling?
Come here and give me a kiss. Do you know how much I have missed you?
What is it? You seem agitated. Ah, I know what you want.
I know, but I cannot give it to you here. Not now.
Easy, my love. Good things come to those who wait. Everything will be arranged in time.
Please don't be angry, darling. It cannot be helped.
Don't run away, dearest. Soon, I promise.
There's my darling. We'll return to my office soon, and I will give you what you want.
